published_implementation.historical_relation: The pinned Salesforce AI Research repository implements the MAS-Orchestra training and inference system, publishes the study result table, and links task-specific trained orchestrator checkpoints. The public aggregate table is treated as a first-party publication surface rather than as an independently reproduced raw-run ledger.

observations.evidence_surface: MAS-Orchestra published IID/OOD benchmark result table across AIME24, AIME25, HotpotQA, BrowseComp+, and GPQA
observations.public_training_configuration_note: The pinned README publishes an example MAS-Orchestra training command with actor_rollout_ref.model.path=Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and gpt-oss-120b agent calls for BrowseComp+, while the public checkpoint table exposes task-specific 7B orchestrator checkpoints for Math/AIME, HotpotQA, and BrowseComp+.
observations.result_summary: The first-party publication reports MAS-Orchestra scores of 66.25 on AIME24, 61.25 on AIME25, 49.00 on HotpotQA, 11.00 on BrowseComp+, and 65.21 on GPQA in its published IID/OOD comparison table.
observations.provenance_limitation: The public repository and project page publish aggregate study results and selected task-specific checkpoints, but this corpus has not independently reproduced the experiments and the repository does not expose one committed per-example run ledger binding a single checkpoint identity to all five aggregate rows. GPQA is presented as an OOD result and does not have a separate checkpoint link in the pinned README checkpoint table.
